purpose: Closed directory of the places of catalog-v2 with their aliases (ID-11, plan section 6.5): a spelling in another language resolves to the canonical name before a unit is built.
limitations: Covers the places of catalog-v2 only; it is not a general place normalizer (P7).
The v1 path (catalog-v1, requests without a route) never uses it.
Any edit requires updating places_sha256 here, and the loader refuses a mismatch.
